title: 解答: 搜索插入位置
summary: 解析如何寻找在排序列表中插入元素的位置。

content.text: ## 解法: 二分查找变形

code_contents.title: search_insert_position
code_contents.content:
def search_insert_position(lst, value):
    """
    A function to search insert position of a given value in a list
    :param lst:  A list of integers
    :param value: An integer
    :return: The position of the value to be in the list
    """

    size = len(lst)

    if size < 1:
        return -1

    start = 0
    end = size - 1

    pos = 0

    while start <= end:
        mid = start + (end - start) // 2

        if lst[mid] == value:
            return mid
        elif lst[mid] > value:
            end = mid - 1
            pos = mid
        else:
            start = mid + 1
            pos = mid + 1

    return pos


# Driver to test above code
if __name__ == '__main__':

    lst = [1, 3, 5, 6]

    value = 5
    print(search_insert_position(lst, value))

    value = 2
    print(search_insert_position(lst, value))

content.text:
### 解释

该解解法是二分搜索算法的简单修改。相比增加了一个变量`pos`追踪正确插入的位置。

### 时间复杂度

与二分搜索类似，复杂度$O(log(n))$。
